question: Who was the last king of the Mauryan dynasty?
solution:
The correct answer is __Brihadratha__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Brihadratha:

 
 
• He was the last ruler of the Mauryan dynasty.
 
• He was assassinated by **Pushyamitra Sunga.**
 
• Pushyamitra Sunga was the Brahmin Commander-in-chief of Brihadratha.
 
• He founded the **Sunga dynasty**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Devvarman **was the successor of **Shalishuka Maurya **and reigned for a short period of seven years.
 
• **Samprati **was an emperor of the Maurya dynasty. He was the son of Ashoka's blind son, **Kunala**, and succeeded his cousin, **Dasharatha**, as emperor of the Maurya Empire. He was a great patron of Jainism.
 
• Chandragupta Maurya was the founder of the Mauryan dynasty.
 
 
• He defeated the Nanda king Dhanananda with the help of Chanakya/Kautilya.
 
 
 
• Ashoka was the son of Bindusar and one of the greatest rulers of the Mauryan Empire.
 
 
• Ashoka fought the battle of Kalinga in **261 BC.**
